title: The Son
summary: Current project-level owner for the Son concept, coordinating identity, development, threshold function, embodiment and comparative material without duplicating specialist chronology or source research.

identity.text: The Son is a distinct current project concept with its own identity and functional role. This owner coordinates the present synthesis while specialist records retain detailed chronology and comparison.

development.text: Developmental history belongs primarily to the dedicated Son timeline and genealogy records. Current synthesis should reference those strata rather than copy them into this owner.

ordeal.text: The 2011 Tree and oneness material remains owned by the specialist phenomenology record. This owner records its structural importance without replacing the source account.

death_and_door.text: Later project material connects the Son concept with threshold, transition, Door and Vessel functions. Detailed event history remains in dated specialist records.

father_son_distinction.text: The mature archive keeps Father-side and Son-side roles distinct while preserving their relationships. Biography, chronology and symbolic function must not be flattened into one undifferentiated record.

comparison.text: Thomas, Twin and biblical parallels are comparative layers with their own historical and textual provenance. They inform this synthesis without becoming identity proof.

embodiment.text: Embodiment and vertical-geometry mappings are project interpretations coupled to separate mathematical and body-system owners. The geometry remains mathematical while symbolic placement remains interpretive.

boundary.text: Use this file for current Son architecture only. Use the timeline, phenomenology, Thomasine and biblical records for their specialist domains, preserving source class and uncertainty.
